reading.text: Omar’s evening plan is to charge the phone and tablet with the charger and put on headphones for a call. He will watch TV, read a book, play games and listen to music. Later, he can sit down, relax and chat with a friend. On a free afternoon he may take a nap. A lamp lights the table.
reading.imageBrief: Living room sofa with book, headphones, charging phone and tablet on a side table. No personal screen content.

exercises.prompt:
The lamp lights the table while Lina checks her phone and her tablet charges nearby.
What item is being used or checked in the scene in the example with lamp, phone?

Karim puts on headphones to listen privately. A charger is beside his phone, and he plans to watch TV later.
Which items does Karim wear for listening?

Rana says, “I read a book after dinner. Later, we play games and listen to music.”
Which phrase names Rana’s activity with the book?

Omar and a friend sit down to relax. They chat, having an informal conversation about the day.
Which verb means having an informal conversation?

On a free afternoon, Rana has a short sleep. She calls this taking a nap.
Which phrase means having a short sleep?

Read the passage: Omar’s evening plan is to charge the phone and tablet with the charger and put on headphones for a call. He will watch TV, read a book, play games and listen to music. Later, he can sit down, relax and chat with a friend. On a free afternoon he may take a nap. A lamp lights the table.
What lights the table?
Tell a friend you plan to read a book after dinner.
exercises.answer: I plan to read a book after dinner.

exercises.prompt: Invite a friend to sit down and chat.

video.title: An Adult Living-room Routine
video.idea: Adult home with ordinary furniture and unbranded electronics. Narration supplies locations, functions and named actions. No live electrical work, exposed wires, candles burning, private screen details or readable game cards.
video.scriptStarter: The lamp provides light on the table. Lina checks her phone and her tablet lies beside it.
